result.summary: Found 3 issues related to text truncation and layout on this food delivery app screen.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' appears cut off/truncated at the right edge, showing 'Tokumaru Ramei' with an abrupt ending.
issues.suggestion: Ensure text containers accommodate full restaurant names or add proper ellipsis truncation with adequate padding from the edge.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge, showing the restaurant is partially visible in the horizontal scroll.
issues.suggestion: This is acceptable for horizontal scroll carousels, but consider adding a subtle gradient fade or peek indicator to make the scrollability more obvious.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icons are inconsistent between cards - one has a white circular background (Tokumaru Ramen) while the other has a dark/transparent background (pizza card), creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon styling across all cards to maintain visual consistency.
